title: foeniculum vulgare f. dulce
intro: Foeniculum vulgare f. dulce, commonly known as sweet fennel, is a variant of the fennel plant (Foeniculum vulgare) that has been cultivated for its seeds and oil. The health benefits of sweet fennel include reducing flatulence, alleviating menstrual cramps, and soothing digestive issues due to its carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of sweet fennel include acting as an analgesic, an anti-inflammatory, and an antispasmodic, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of sweet fennel include anethole, fenchone, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aroma.
